title: John Keel's non-government Men in Black

tellings.quote: often wrote about the types of men in black cases that Keel recounts where clearly they're not government agents.

plain: In the 1960s, according to the philosopher Jason Jorjani, a writer named John Keel collected cases of Men in Black, the mysterious visitors in dark suits said to call on UFO witnesses, where the visitors "clearly" were not government agents. Jorjani says this on the show in passing, citing Keel's accounts. If so, the visitors would be something other than officials hushing things up.
